validationRepairs: Before baseline freeze, a readonly-view helper declared an unsupported Symbol.toStringTag member. The type-only declaration was removed and all original/predecessor/prototype captures agreed; the rejected draft is retained.
Before timing acceptance, the IPC worker needed an explicit non-null process.disconnect call for the game compiler. The rejected type-check receipt is retained.

The full package check caught the new 2398-byte module in a historical component budget. It now has an explicit 3 KiB bound while remaining counted in the unchanged 96 KiB core and 674 KiB whole-package limits; the 733-byte stats integration remains charged to the old component limits.

The completion inventory initially linked this not-yet-written evidence file. The verifier rejected the missing path. That premature link was removed; the inventory references existing baseline, implementation tests and documentation instead. Both failed full-check reports are retained.

Hosted Windows MSVC 19.51 exposed recursive diagnostic observer stack exhaustion on predecessor 1960ca3, after two requests. The native harness now uses an explicitly stacked depth-first observer, independently compared with the frozen original. No fixture, gameplay runtime, tolerance or VM stack limit was changed. The original failed log is retained; the new hosted compiler result remains separate from this local result.
